<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: War Room''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：戦闘指揮所</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：ここで戦闘を宣言した場合、戦闘運命数を1回多く加える。ダークサイド：ここを支配し、かつここにリーダーがいる場合、全ての反乱軍兵士とYウイングは没収値－1となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-287o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: War Room.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: If you initiate a battle here, add one battle destiny. Dark Side: If you control and a leader is here, all Rebel Troopers and Y-wings are forfeit -1.

'''Lore:'''
